sn22.158:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave, sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa uppajjanti saññojanābhinivesavinibandhājjhosānāti?
sn22.158:1.4: rūpe kho bhikkhave, sati rūpaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa uppajjanti saññojanābhinivesavinibandhājjhosānā.
sn22.158:1.8: viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa uppajjanti sññojanābhinivesavinibandhājjhosānā.
sn22.158:1.12: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti? dukkhaṃ bhante, yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ
sn22.158:1.13: api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyyuṃ saññojanābhinivesavinibandhājjhosānāti? no hetaṃ bhante, vedanā …pe… saññā …pe… saṅkhārā …pe… viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti? aniccaṃ bhante. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti? dukkhaṃ bhante, yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyyuṃ saññojanābhinivesavinibandhājjhosānāti?
